title: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

release_status.framework_code: Official project site source marks Code Coming soon

evidence_boundaries: Unified testbed rather than a new VLA architecture
Main policy comparison fixes SONIC but retains model-specific observations, preprocessing and optimization
Unseen-scene split changes task definitions and scenes together
Controller comparisons retrain policy-controller pairs with controller-specific demonstrations
All motion-quality metrics except success rate use successful episodes only
Source-mixture experiment does not match dataset size or sampling exposure
Kimodo 90.7 percent is a 30 task-scene-pair result, partly overlapping adaptation conditions, not the 234-task main benchmark
Real-world policies train on real demonstrations; not zero-shot sim-to-real policy transfer
Single training run per configuration, no multi-seed uncertainty estimate
